links.outcome: Readability scores of LLM patient education materials with vs without 5th-grade prompt
links.effect: Prompting for a 5th-grade level consistently produced statistically lower readability scores than unprompted outputs; no numeric values given in the abstract.
links.quote: Prompting LLMs to produce PEMs at a 5th-grade level consistently produced statistically lower readability scores than unprompted outputs.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering to target a specified reading grade level in LLM-generated patient education materials

screen.reason: Evaluates whether prompting large language models with reading-level constraints improves the readability score of generated patient education materials compared to unprompted outputs.
